name: @epoch/execution-tracking-runtime
description: Epoch Execution Tracking Runtime service (W038): the thin typed HOST FACADE over @epoch/execution-tracking — program registration (the opaque work-package/activity/milestone index over the REAL W036 ProgramOfWork), delivery-record registration, the low-friction field-capture intake through the FieldCapturePort adapter seam (ONE in-memory reference adapter; the core never names a vendor) and through direct calls, observation recording with IDEMPOTENT replay (same capture content -> the typed duplicate-observation admission returning the prior digest; state unchanged), tracking-state transitions (append-only chains), issue raising/resolution (changes/delays/rework/defects/blockers), reconciliation proposals and their application EXCLUSIVELY through the W036 DeliveryRecord authority path (recordObservation -> acceptObservation -> actualizeObservation), and the derived execution-state projection. Every step emits execution:* events (W010-shaped, one stream per work package stream:execution-<suffix>) sealed by the kernel and pinned by REAL sealEvent parity tests. The W009 authorization gate denies unauthorized operations BEFORE any kernel admission; tenant isolation is typed tenant-isolation-rejected. In-memory reference behavior: NO persistence, NO network, NO real field systems; core logic stays pure (zero wall-clock, zero randomness — instants are caller-supplied).
